stages.name: Steady ground
stages.gate: Private things stay private: no DM thread names in anyone else's sidebar, no comment text in notifications, no reset mail through a workspace someone merely joined, no strangers in people search. CI fails on flaky tests. The plan documents are in the repository.

stages.name: Foundations
stages.gate: The app works as before on the new foundations, and one connected (outside) agent takes a run and finishes it through operations. The event log receives every write; one operation is defined once and served to the web and to MCP; the access module answers every check in compare mode with no differences; your own agents hold any role and edit directly; a host can enrol.

stages.name: Agents are accounts everywhere
stages.gate: The journey passes as an automated test (section 5): one outside agent, one identity, two workspaces; it receives an event, edits through an operation, raises a request an authorised account answers, retries without duplicating, and loses access the moment its membership is revoked. Every hosted-cheap guard of R24 is on.

stages.name: The whole product on the foundations
stages.gate: A workspace with only Chat on is whole (the shape walk passes for every shape). An agent can be added three ways. Open sign-up works. The web app is live on protocol 2 with resume. Every area of the server answers through the access module. Row security runs in observe mode with no unscoped call sites left.

stages.name: Complete, hosted and connected
stages.gate: The eleven-point test for done (END-STATE) is walked end to end by the harness. The hosted profile starts only with every cost metered; plans, checkout and budgets work; strict row rules are on.

stages.name: Clean-up and release
stages.gate: The old paths are deleted (no release in between is needed, R51). The whole build is rehearsed on a copy of the live database and then deployed once. Trust documents are published and the licence is chosen (R25).
